name: AeroPlayer
changelog:
• Crystal Clear Dialogue & Voice Boost: Integrated intelligent multi-channel speech downmix matrix (pan) for 5.1 and 7.1 surround tracks (like EAC3 in Ozark/web series); lifts center dialogue by +7dB while balancing overpowering background music, bass rumble, and explosions so speech is crisp, punchy, and clearly intelligible
• One-Click Voice Boost & Shortcut: Added dedicated Voice Boost toggle in player controls, context menu, and keyboard shortcut (D); boosts voice presence (~1.9kHz) while filtering out boomy sub-200Hz room rumble
• Instant Voice Boost Memory: Remembers your Voice Boost preference in local storage across app restarts and series episodes
• Zero Extra CPU & GPU Overhead: Downmix matrix runs seamlessly during existing remux stream arithmetic (<0.5% CPU, 0% GPU load)
• Includes all v1.3.11 A/V sync and J/K/L navigation improvements
